tips.text: Build the Dual Skana on day one and level it while the Tenno Lab research and the Mutagen Mass wait.
Farm the 10 Mutagen Mass built instead of crafting it; crafting costs 100 Mutagen Samples and 10 Control Modules.
Start the 72-hour Bio Lab Mutagen Mass research on day one if you will craft it; it is the longest wait in the chain.
Expect to build it for Mastery and shelve it; nobody complains about the farm.
